title: Chronic Exposure to Low Levels of Parabens Increases Mammary Cancer Growth and Metastasis in Mice.
authors: Tong, Jason H; Elmore, Sarah; Huang, Shenq-Shyang; Tachachartvanich, Phum; Manz, Katherine; Pennell, Kurt; Wilson, Machelle D; Borowsky, Alexander; La Merrill, Michele A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究尼泊金酯暴露促进小鼠乳腺癌生长与转移，虽含分子对接验证雌激素受体结合，但核心是毒理学与肿瘤表型，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Methylparaben (MP) and propylparaben (PP) are commonly used as food, cosmetic, and drug preservatives. These parabens are detected in the majority of US women and children, bind and activate estrogen receptors (ER), and stimulate mammary tumor cell growth and invasion in vitro. Hemizygous B6.FVB-Tg (MMTV-PyVT)634Mul/LellJ female mice (n = 20/treatment) were exposed to MP or PP at levels within the US Food and Drug Administration's "human acceptable daily intake." These paraben-exposed mice had increased mammary tumor volume compared with control mice (P < 0.001) and a 28% and 91% increase in the number of pulmonary metastases per week compared with the control mice, respectively (P < 0.0001). MP and PP caused differential expression of 288 and 412 mammary tumor genes, respectively (false discovery rate < 0.05), a subset of which has been associated with human breast cancer metastasis. Molecular docking and luciferase reporter studies affirmed that MP and PP bound and activated human ER, and RNA-sequencing revealed increased ER expression in mammary tumors among paraben-exposed mice. However, ER signaling was not enriched in mammary tumors. Instead, both parabens strongly impaired tumor RNA metabolism (eg, ribosome, spliceosome), as evident from enriched KEGG pathway analysis of differential mammary tumor gene expression common to both paraben treatments (MP, P < 0.001; PP, P < 0.01). Indeed, mammary tumors from PP-exposed mice had an increased retention of introns (P < 0.05). Our data suggest that parabens cause substantial mammary cancer metastasis in mice as a function of their increasing alkyl chain length and highlight the emerging role of aberrant spliceosome activity in breast cancer metastasis.
abstract_zh: 对羟基苯甲酸甲酯（MP）和对羟基苯甲酸丙酯（PP）常用作食品、化妆品和药物防腐剂。这些对羟基苯甲酸酯在美国大多数女性和儿童体内被检测到，能与雌激素受体（ER）结合并激活之，并在体外刺激乳腺肿瘤细胞生长和侵袭。半合子B6.FVB-Tg (MMTV-PyVT)634Mul/LellJ雌性小鼠（每组n = 20）暴露于美国食品药品监督管理局“人类可接受每日摄入量”范围内的MP或PP。与对照组小鼠相比，这些暴露于对羟基苯甲酸酯的小鼠乳腺肿瘤体积增加（P < 0.001），且每周肺转移数量分别比对照组小鼠增加28%和91%（P < 0.0001）。MP和PP分别导致288个和412个乳腺肿瘤基因的差异表达（错误发现率 < 0.05），其中一部分基因与人类乳腺癌转移相关。分子对接和荧光素酶报告基因研究证实，MP和PP能结合并激活人类ER，RNA测序显示，暴露于对羟基苯甲酸酯的小鼠乳腺肿瘤中ER表达增加。然而，ER信号在乳腺肿瘤中并未富集。相反，两种对羟基苯甲酸酯均强烈损害肿瘤RNA代谢（如核糖体、剪接体），这从两种对羟基苯甲酸酯处理共有的差异乳腺肿瘤基因表达富集的KEGG通路分析中可见（MP，P < 0.001；PP，P < 0.01）。确实，暴露于PP的小鼠乳腺肿瘤中内含子保留增加（P < 0.05）。我们的数据表明，对羟基苯甲酸酯随着其烷基链长度的增加，在小鼠中引起显著的乳腺癌转移，并突显了异常剪接体活性在乳腺癌转移中的新兴作用。
